description: Source code for a wizard in the OpenERP (Odoo) system that handles closing tasks and sending notification emails to customers.

classes.name: wizard_close
classes.description: Wizard class managing the process of closing a project task and optionally sending an email notification.

methods.name: _check_complete
methods.description: Checks if the task's project requires customer notification before closing.

methods.name: _get_data
methods.description: Retrieves email and description data for the task to prepare for email notification.

methods.name: _data_send
methods.description: Sends an email notification about the task closure if email data is provided.

methods.name: _do_close
methods.description: Performs the actual closing of the task.
